title: Threat-Intel-2025-14
summary: Threat intelligence advisory tracking adversary abuse of LOLBins (rundll32.exe, certutil.exe) for memory dumping and in-memory payload staging.
content:
Recent campaigns show adversaries using custom tooling and LOLBins (such as rundll32.exe executing comsvcs.dll) to access and dump LSASS memory.

Analysts should filter for System Event ID 10 targeting lsass.exe within the last 24 hours to identify the source process and access mask.

Cross-reference running processes and loaded modules against known credential-dumping tool hashes. Inspect network egress connections originating from system binaries.

steps.title: Kill rogue child processes spawned from LOLBins
steps.description: Terminate rogue instances of rundll32.exe, certutil.exe, or mshta.exe executing suspicious in-memory script payloads or unauthorized DLL exports.

steps.title: Inspect Sysmon Event ID 10 and DLL access masks for rundll32
steps.description: Examine process handles targeting lsass.exe created by rundll32.exe and verify whether MiniDumpWriteDump was invoked via comsvcs.dll.

steps.title: Cross-reference running processes with known T1003.001 hashes
steps.description: Compare active process memory images and loaded unsigned modules against threat intelligence hashes associated with recent credential dumping toolkits.

steps.title: Enforce AppLocker / WDAC script-execution policies
steps.description: Strengthen application control policies to restrict unsigned DLL invocation via rundll32 and block unauthorized scripts in user-writable directories.
